name: io.github.lukebmandel-debug/alto-connector
description: Build an interactive timeline from your own materials — never from invented content.

environmentVariables.name: ALTO_STORE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where timelines are kept on this machine.

environmentVariables.name: ALTO_FIREBASE_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Your own Firebase Hosting site id, for publishing shareable links.

environmentVariables.name: ALTO_FIREBASE_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: The Firebase project that site belongs to.

environmentVariables.name: ALTO_FIREBASE_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Your Firebase web SDK config JSON, which enables cross-device sync of highlights and notes. Alto never ships a project of its own.
